image_description: A low-angle, close-up view of an ornate, baroque-style pipe organ facade. The image features multiple vertical pipes of varying sizes, heavily decorated with gold leaf, floral motifs, and sculptural elements. The pipes appear to be made of metal with a reflective finish, set within a dark, carved wooden structure. The perspective is steep, looking up at the instrument.
